newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BRL Hardy buys 32 hectare vineyard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BRL Hardy buys 32 hectare vineyard.

text.p: Australia's second largest wine producer BRL Hardy Ltd said on Wednesday it had further expanded its premium wine business with the acquisition of a 32 hectare vineyard in the McLaren Vale region, south of Adelaide.

BRL managing director Stephen Millar said in a statement the Yeenunga vineyard, planted with predominantly premium red varieties, had been the source of much of the company's premium McLaren Vale fruit in recent years.
In the past three years BRL Hardy had committed A$50 million to investments in new vineyards and vineyard land, he said.
